description:
## Bitcoin India Tour. IIT Goa Edition

Bitcoin India Tour is a nationwide educational initiative bringing Bitcoin education to students across India. The tour explores the evolution of money, the problems with existing monetary systems, and the technology behind Bitcoin from first principles.

The IIT Goa Edition at the Indian Institute of Technology Goa brings an engaging learning experience for students interested in technology, computer science, economics, finance, and the future of money.

Starting with the fundamentals of money and moving into the technology behind Bitcoin, this session is designed to help students understand why Bitcoin was created, how it works, and what makes it different from traditional monetary systems

What You'll Learn

- The evolution of money and how monetary systems have changed
- Inflation, purchasing power, and the importance of sound money
- Problems with the current monetary system
- What Bitcoin is and why it was created
- Bitcoin's fixed supply and monetary properties
- How the Bitcoin network works
- Bitcoin mining, nodes, blocks, and network security
- Global Bitcoin adoption and real-world use cases
- Opportunities to learn, build, research, and contribute to the Bitcoin ecosyste

Who Should Attend?

- Engineering and technology students
- Developers and aspiring builders
- Students interested in economics and finance
- Entrepreneurs and innovators
- Anyone curious about Bitcoin and the future of money

No prior knowledge of Bitcoin is required

Event Format

Educational Bitcoin session Interactive presentation and demonstrations Bitcoin technology and fundamentals Open discussion Networking with fellow students and Bitcoin enthusiasts Q&A sessio

About Bitcoin India Tour

Bitcoin India Tour is building a grassroots Bitcoin education movement across Indian campuses, creating opportunities for students to learn about money, understand Bitcoin, ask questions, and connect with like-minded individuals.

Join us at IIT Goa to learn Bitcoin from first principles and explore the ideas and technology shaping the future of money

name: Ethereum Classic Mumbai
description:
Ethereum and Ethereum Classic were once the same chain, until the DAO hard fork in 2016 sent them down separate paths. Ethereum later moved to Proof of Stake, while Classic stayed with Proof of Work. Ten years on, ETC enters its second decade, and every chain now faces new threats from quantum computers and AI.

We're a 15-minute walk from Ethereum Cypherpunk Congress #3 (https://congress.web3privacy.info/), and we invite you to this casual evening after it closes, the night before Devcon 8 opens, to pull up a chair and talk with Ethereum Classic developers and contributors.

Who It's For

Builders on any EVM chain, node runners and miners, Congress and Devcon people, and anyone curious about Ethereum Classic.

Let's Talk About

We think ETC, the EVM chain with the greatest hash rate, is going to make a comeback.

Quantum computers threaten the elliptic-curve signatures every chain uses today, but ETC's consensus rests on hash-based Proof of Work, which shouldn't need to be migrated. Mining a block takes real hardware and energy, and there are no validator keys to steal or forge. Wallets are a different story, and we still need to figure out post-quantum signatures for ETC accounts, looking to Ethereum's research on this for inspiration.

Coming straight from the Cypherpunk Congress, we also thought it would be interesting to talk about the cypherpunk ideas ETC was built on, like censorship resistance and protocol neutrality, and about EVM symbiosis, since ETC and Ethereum share the EVM and the same contracts, tools and builders can work on both.

We think ETC is an underdog with a bright future, carried through ten years by people who stayed for principles that never die

name: Can Regulated, Tokenized Assets Trade on Open Onchain Markets? Live Demo & Panel at Hong Kong Fintech Week
description:
Can Regulated, Tokenized Assets Trade on Open Onchain Markets? is a closed-door session co-hosted by OpenZeppelin and Ethereum Institutional during Hong Kong Fintech Week, limited to 30 senior participants from banks, market infrastructure, and regulated asset issuers.

Bringing regulated assets onto open onchain markets raises real questions for institutions, from who enforces eligibility rules to how investor data stays protected, and there are good reasons most activity still runs on permissioned platforms.

This session explores what is technically possible today and where the open questions remain. Through a live walkthrough of a tokenized money market fund trading on an open onchain market, we'll look at how identity checks can run at every trade without personal data onchain, how a transfer agent can freeze an investor and have the market respect it on the next trade, and how a jurisdiction can be switched off while everyone else keeps trading.

A panel of industry experts then debates who should hold the keys when regulated assets meet open markets, and what it takes for institutions to go live. We close with a drinks reception.

Previous OpenZeppelin institutional events drew senior guests from firms including J.

P. Morgan, Citi, UBS, Morgan Stanley, Bank of America, BNY, Fidelity, Mastercard, Deloitte, and more

description:
Join Nara, Hex Trust and XDC Network during Hong Kong FinTech Week to explore opportunities at the intersection of Web3 and traditional finance, covering yield-bearing stablecoins, digital asset custody and Layer 1 protocols.

Connect with industry leaders for an insightful panel discussion and networking

:

About Nara

Nara is a PayFi protocol offering a yield-bearing synthetic dollar backed by short-term financing against payment and receivables flows. Stablecoin payments are moving faster than the liquidity infrastructure around them. Stablecoins can settle near-instantly, but many payment companies still need to bridge delays between fiat collection, on/off-ramp conversion, local payout settlement, and stablecoin funding. That timing gap creates working-capital demand. Nara is the liquidity layer for the stablecoin economy because our goal is not simply to produce yield; our goal is to finance useful payment activity with transparent risk allocation.

About Hex Trust

Hex Trust is a fully-licensed and regulated financial institution for digital assets. It offers a full suite of Markets services, OTC trading, Custody, Staking and Investment Solutions to builders, investors, and service providers. Hex Trust have a global presence with offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai.

The mission is to unlock ownership in decentralized markets, with a vision to secure the permissionless future.

About XDC Network

XDC Network is an enterprise-grade Layer 1 blockchain designed to support trade finance, payments, and the tokenization of real-world assets. Its EVM-compatible infrastructure provides fast settlement, low transaction costs, and energy-efficient performance, enabling institutions, businesses, and developers to build scalable blockchain solutions. Learn more at xinfin.org (https://xinfin.org).

We look forward to welcoming you for a morning of insightful discussions, meaningful connections and new opportunities at the intersection of Web3 and traditional finance.

name: RWA 2.0:从资产上链到金融机会触达
description:
一、活動背景

Openvault 將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日 聯合 Techub News 在香港灣仔舉辦主題活動 「RWA 2.0:從資產上鏈到金融機會觸達」。

香港金融科技周 x StartmeupHK 是亞洲規模最大、影響力最廣的金融科技旗艦盛會。2026 年,兩大盛事進一步合流,以「Fintech Nexus:Bridging the World, Building the Future」為主題,圍繞 AI+、Finance+、Go Global 三大引擎展開,匯聚來自全球 120+ 經濟體的 45,000+ 行業領袖、1,000+ 演講嘉賓、800+ 贊助商/參展商/初創企業,以及 30+ 內地與國際貿易代表團。主論壇於 11 月 2-3 日在香港會議展覽中心舉行,隨後一週延伸至全港多個場地及粵港澳大灣區,舉辦數百場社區與周邊活動。

在金融科技週數百場周邊活動之中,「RWA 2.0」聚焦其中最接近落地的一段賽道:資產完成上鏈之後,金融機會如何真正觸達市場。

───────────────────────────

二、主題闡釋:為什麼是 RWA 2.0

過去兩年,RWA 完成了從概念驗證到批量發行的第一步。政府數字債券、代幣化基金、私募信貸等項目相繼落地,香港的監管框架與沙盒機制亦逐步成型。

資產上鏈解決的是「發行」問題。 債券、基金、私募信貸、商業地產等傳統資產透過代幣化進入鏈上世界,獲得了可分割、可編程、可跨境流轉的新形態。

但發行不等於流動性,上鏈不等於被配置。 分銷渠道能否打通持牌體系?專業投資者如何在合規框架下完成認購與轉讓?二級市場的深度從何而來?這些「最後一公里」的問題,決定 RWA 是停留在技術敘事,還是成為真實的資產類別。

這正是 RWA 2.0 的命題:從「能發行」走向「有人買」。 活動將匯聚資產發行方、資產管理機構、持牌交易平台與合規專業人士,圍繞分銷機制、流動性建設與投資者觸達路徑,分享一線實踐與監管觀察。

三、活動信息

- 日期與時間:2026 年 11 月 4 日(星期三)14:00. 18:00
- 地點:香港灣仔
- 主辦:Openvault | 聯合主辦:Techub News

name: London Workshop: Vaults in Practice – How Financial Institutions Capture Onchain Yield
description:
This workshop provides a structured, case-study-driven deep dive into onchain vaults as the key primitive of DeFi and tokenized capital markets, led by Steakhouse Financial.

Starting from familiar concepts such as funds and ETFs, the session explains how vaults represent the next step in the evolution of asset management. combining programmable execution, non-custodial design, and real-time risk management. Participants will gain a practical understanding of how vaults work, how they differ from traditional investment vehicles, and why they are increasingly adopted by institutions.

The discussion then moves from fundamentals into live production environments, examining how vaults are deployed, operated, and integrated today. This includes institutional use cases such as platform integrations, as well as operational and compliance considerations when running vault strategies in regulated contexts.

From there, the workshop explores where vault management is expanding next, using concrete production case studies curated and operated by Steakhouse Financial:

- RWA as collateral (Fasanara mF-ONE)
- Fixed-term lending and yield structuring via Pendle
- Leveraged vault strategies (Steakhouse High Yield Turbo)

By the end of the session, attendees will have a clear, example-driven understanding of how vaults are used in practice today, and how the frontier of vault management is shaping the next generation of institutional onchain products.

About Steakhouse Financial Steakhouse Financial is the leading curator on DeFi Money Markets (Morpho, Kamino), building earn products for the future of the stablecoin economy. Steakhouse Financial operates at the intersection of real world assets, protocol design, and data-driven DeFi portfolio management. They aspire to empower the world with institutional-grade DeFi tools to raise, manage and distribute the capital they need to make a difference.

For questions, please contact: mail@blockstories.io

name: Bitcoin on Sui: Getting Started with Hashi
description:
Bitcoin is the largest pool of idle capital in crypto, and most of it never moves, because using it anywhere else has meant handing it to a custodian or a wrapped-token bridge. Hashi is Sui's answer. Your BTC stays on Bitcoin, held at an address controlled jointly by Hashi's validator committee, which signs with threshold MPC, and an independent guardian layer. Against it, hBTC is minted on Sui and works across Sui apps. Burn the hBTC and the BTC is released back on Bitcoin. Hashi is now live on Sui mainnet in a phased rollout, partners first, backed by more than $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners including Anchorage Digital. In early November about 9.6 hBTC had been minted onchain, and you can watch that number grow. This session explains how Hashi works under the hood and gets you building with it. We read the live mainnet deployment directly: the Hashi object, the deposit and withdrawal queues, the committee and the hBTC supply. Then we use the Hashi TypeScript SDK on testnet with Bitcoin signet to run the full user journey: generate a personal Bitcoin deposit address for a Sui account, send signet BTC to it, follow the deposit through committee approval until hBTC is minted, and request a withdrawal back to Bitcoin. You build hBTC Desk, a small app that runs the testnet round trip and shows the live mainnet numbers beside it. What You'll Learn - How Hashi keeps BTC on Bitcoin: per-account deposit addresses, joint control by the validator committee and the guardian layer, threshold MPC signing, and how hBTC is minted and burned - What is live today: reading the mainnet package, the deposit and withdrawal queues and the hBTC supply with GraphQL, and what a phased rollout means for builders - The SDK: @mysten/hashi, generating a deposit address, submitting a deposit, tracking its status, and requesting or cancelling a withdrawal - Building on hBTC: using it like any other Sui coin in your own Move code and programmable transactions, with 8 decimals and integer base units from end to end - Honest limits: the SDK is pre-1.0 and not yet wired to mainnet, deposits wait for Bitcoin confirmations and a time delay, and how to show pending states so nobody pays twice - How to ship hBTC Desk: deposit signet BTC, watch hBTC arrive on Sui testnet, withdraw back to a Bitcoin address, and compare it with the live mainnet numbers

Who Should Attend - DeFi builders who want Bitcoin as collateral in lending, trading or vaults - Wallet and payments teams that want to hold and move BTC inside Sui apps - Developers who joined the bridging and CCTP sessions and want the Bitcoin side of the story - Bitcoin holders curious how BTC can be used on another chain without giving up custody to a single company What to Bring - Laptop with Node.js 22+ and pnpm, and the latest @mysten/sui and @mysten/hashi - A Sui testnet wallet - A Bitcoin wallet that supports signet, such as Sparrow. We share a signet faucet in class - Basic TypeScript. No Bitcoin scripting required Join us at SuiHub to learn, build, and connect with fellow developers pushing the boundaries of the Sui ecosystem.

name: Race Against the Machine: AI, Quantum and the Future of Bitcoin
description:
## Intro

Almost everything we trust online, from banking and web traffic to messaging and digital identity, rests on public-key cryptography. Two threats are now calling that very foundation into question. Quantum computers could break today's signatures and key exchange, with the hardware required shrinking steadily. AI could reach the same result with breakthroughs in mathematics, and it is already helping quantum attacks along by optimizing the circuits behind them.

The synergy between them is unmistakable, and even the post-quantum schemes meant to replace today's cryptography may not be safe either. With finance and the internet facing a long, fragmented migration, the stakes are highest where cryptography protects value directly. Cryptocurrencies add their own exposure: public keys sit on a public ledger, assets are bearer instruments, and theft is irreversible. Given Bitcoin's history, the challenge is particularly acute: every serious option (do nothing, freeze, force a deadline) violates a principle the Bitcoin community cares about, and the work must start before the threat is visible.

Join us at this interdisciplinary event where AI, quantum and Bitcoin experts come together in a novel panel to discuss the technical foundations of this challenge and its potential solutions

Program

17:00 Arrival 17:30 Intro 17:35 Keynote 1: Quantum 17:55 Keynote 2: Bitcoin 18:15 Q&A 19:00 Networkin

Speakers

Wadim Wormsbecher:

> Theoretical physicist turned tech innovator. With a PhD from Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin and a background developing AI products, Wadim now works at Bundesdruckerei focusing on applied cybersecurity in the era of Quantum and AI. His focus goes beyond hardware. AI-driven discoveries and algorithmic improvements can reduce the resources needed to challenge today's cryptography. Understanding these shifts is essential to assessing quantum threats and making informed security decisions. > > https://www.linkedin.com/in/wadimwormsbecher/

Fabian Jahr:

> Fabian Jahr has contributed to Bitcoin Core since 2019 and currently works on it full-time with a grant from Brink. He reviews critical changes to Bitcoin Core, develops ASMap for a more decentralized peer-to-peer network, and researches protocol upgrades. With the support of the Human Rights Foundation, he published a report on how Cross-Input Signature Aggregation could change Bitcoin, and he is now turning it into a soft fork proposal with BIPs 458 to 460. > > https://fjahr.com/ https://brink.dev/

Manuel Moran:

> Over the past 12 years, Manuel has built software across research, media, and both traditional and decentralized finance. His path has run from software engineering, through data science and machine learning, to AI engineering, where he now owns end-to-end agentic workflows. At the ephesto consultancy he collaborates with experts in design, strategy, finance, and law to help organizations stay competitive as AI redefines what it takes to be successful. > > https://ephesto.com/

name: Whitepaper Reading [SF] - Defi Topics: No Place to Hide & Active Liquidity On Chain
description:
Discussion Topics As more trading moves through private RPCs and protected submission channels, the question is how much safety those protections actually buy. No Place to Hide examines three years of activity across six chains and finds sandwich attacks against supposedly protected transactions on four of them. The exposure comes from order-flow auctions, validators, applications, reorgs, and even an RPC bug. We'll ask what "protected" should mean when keeping a trade out of the public mempool still leaves multiple ways for attackers to see it coming, and whether protection can hold without securing the full path from wallet to execution. We'll also cover Active Liquidity On Chain, a study of proprietary AMMs across Solana, Base, and Monad. These venues let a single operator supply inventory and update prices without waiting for a trade, helping them avoid the stale quotes that arbitrageurs exploit in passive AMMs. The paper finds better prices for flow used as a proxy for retail trading, alongside pricing that varies by counterparty and evidence of quotes that worsen at execution. The core discussion is whether tighter spreads justify opaque pricing rules, and how aggregators should route trades when the price they see may differ from the price users receive. Reading Overview
No Place to Hide: Where private transaction protections fail, and what it takes to secure the full path from wallet to execution.
Active Liquidity On Chain: How proprietary AMMs improve pricing, and the trade-offs around transparency, routing, and execution quality. Full Documents
No Place to Hide (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28115)
Active Liquidity On Chain (https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38056) Format
- 10 minutes of silent reading to start.
Discussion first, with no panels.
Bring questions - technical depth is welcomed.
Short notes and key takeaways shared after the session. About Whitepaper Reading Club Whitepaper Reading Club is a community of 800 builders, founders, and researchers across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Lagos, Bangkok, and New York. The community meets in person every month to discuss the latest blockchain projects. The club creates detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and has held more than 70 sessions since June 2023, covering topics from Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, and EIPs to the Bitcoin ecosystem and AI × crypto. It is ecosystem-agnostic and not for profit, with a strong focus on projects with technical, product, or social innovations. Dimes, our community partner, connects builders with the people, resources, and support to turn ideas into reality. Our host venue, localhost, is Dimes' co-working and event space in downtown San Francisco, created for builders to meet, share ideas, and connect. We're excited to host this event with Whitepaper Reading Club. #Crypto

description:
## ¡La Casa de Satoshi cumple dos años! ¿Quieres pagar con Bitcoin? Encontrarás las instrucciones al final de esta página. Para celebrarlo, estamos preparando el evento más grande que hemos organizado hasta ahora: un domingo completo dedicado a la comunidad Bitcoin de México, a las personas que la hacen posible y a los proyectos que están construyendo su futuro. Para esta celebración nos hemos aliado con Rodrigo Coutiño, reconocido autor de libros best seller como MoneyCoach, InvestorCoach y BusinessCoach, para presentar el lanzamiento oficial de su nueva obra: BitcoinCoach. El domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 reuniremos en La Casa de Satoshi a emprendedores, comunidades, empresas, educadores y bitcoiners de todo el país. Será una celebración de todo lo que hemos construido juntos durante estos dos años y, al mismo tiempo, el comienzo de una nueva etapa para La Casa de Satoshi.

## Durante el evento tendremos: El lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach, presentado por su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. Después de la presentación, Rodrigo convivirá con la comunidad y firmará ejemplares del libro. Lightning pitches de proyectos y empresas Bitcoin en México. Hasta diez participantes tendrán entre dos y tres minutos para compartir lo que están construyendo. La historia de La Casa de Satoshi y un anuncio especial sobre su futuro, presentado por Santiago Varela Belmont junto con el equipo de la Casa. ₿ Un anuncio especial de Aureo, presentado por Gustavo Flores Echaiz, seguido del arranque oficial de la fiesta. Una gran parrillada para celebrar el aniversario. Música, convivencia y muchas oportunidades para conocer a las personas que están impulsando Bitcoin en México.

## ¿Qué incluye tu boleto? Un ejemplar de BitcoinCoach de Rodrigo Coutiño, con un precio habitual de $389 MXN en Amazon. Conoce el libro aquí (https://investor.com.mx/bitcoincoach/). Acceso a todas las presentaciones y actividades del programa. Parrillada y bebidas. Si ya has venido a alguna de nuestras fiestas, sabes que se pone bueno. ¡La fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! Maciej Cepnik será el maestro de ceremonias. Este encuentro es para toda la comunidad: quienes han estado con nosotros desde el comienzo, quienes se han sumado durante estos dos años y quienes visitarán La Casa de Satoshi por primera vez. Queremos reunir en un mismo lugar a la comunidad Bitcoin más grande de México para celebrar lo que ya existe, descubrir nuevos proyectos y compartir todo lo que viene. Las empresas, startups y proyectos participantes se anunciarán próximamente.

## Programa preliminar 12:00 p. m. | Apertura de puertas y recepción Registro, convivencia y recepción de asistentes. ¡Llega temprano! Tendremos sorpresas, libros y mucho más para quienes nos acompañen desde el inicio. 1:00-1:30 p. m. | Lanzamiento oficial de BitcoinCoach Presentación del nuevo libro con su autor, Rodrigo Coutiño. 1:30-2:00 p. m. | Lightning pitches Hasta diez presentaciones de proyectos, empresas y comunidades que trabajan con Bitcoin en México. Cada participante tendrá entre dos y tres minutos, con breves intervenciones entre las presentaciones. 2:00-2:15 p. m. | La historia y el futuro de La Casa de Satoshi Celebración de los dos años, presentación del equipo y anuncio especial de Santiago Varela Belmont sobre la nueva etapa de La Casa de Satoshi. 2:15-2:30 p. m. | Anuncio especial de Aureo y arranque de la fiesta Presentación de Gustavo Flores Echaiz y apertura oficial de la celebración. A partir de las 2:30 p. m. | Parrillada y fiesta de aniversario Firma de libros y fotografías con Rodrigo Coutiño, música, comida, convivencia y networking con la comunidad. 7:00 p. m. | Cierre del evento Los horarios son aproximados y podrán ajustarse conforme confirmemos a los proyectos, empresas e invitados participantes. La Casa de Satoshi, Ciudad de México Domingo 15 de noviembre de 2026 Puertas abiertas desde las 12:00 p. m. Inicio del programa a la 1:00 p. m. Ven a celebrar con nosotros dos años de encuentros, aprendizaje, amistad y construcción comunitaria. ¡Nos vemos en la gran fiesta de aniversario de La Casa de Satoshi! ₿

name: ¿Qué aporta una Blockchain regulada? - Encuentro #139 SuperPioneros
description:
SuperPioneros · Encuentro #139

📅 Lunes 16 de noviembre · 17:30h
📍 Madrid Innovation Lab · Madrid

Durante años hemos hablado de las posibilidades de Blockchain. Pero ahora que empresas, instituciones y desarrolladores empiezan a construir soluciones reales, surge una nueva pregunta:

👉 ¿Qué aporta realmente una Blockchain regulada frente a otras infraestructuras?

El próximo 16 de noviembre celebramos nuestro Encuentro #139 de SuperPioneros, donde reuniremos a empresas, instituciones, emprendedores y builders para debatir sobre el papel de las nuevas infraestructuras Blockchain L1 reguladas y las oportunidades que abren para el ecosistema.

Y lo haremos junto a ISBE, la iniciativa de Alastria para impulsar una infraestructura Blockchain pública permisionada, diseñada para facilitar el desarrollo de casos de uso empresariales

🎙️ LOS PROTAGONISTAS

Contaremos con:

👉 Miguel Calero, Director Ejecutivo de ISBE, quien compartirá la visión del proyecto, su evolución y las oportunidades que ofrece a empresas y desarrolladores.

👉 José Luis Cáceres, CEO de NWC10 y SuperPioneros, quien conducirá el encuentro y conectará el debate con los desafíos y oportunidades de nuestra Comunidad.

Próximamente anunciaremos nuevos invitados y empresas con casos de uso reales

🔥 ¿DE QUÉ HABLAREMOS?

Queremos abrir una conversación que vaya más allá de la tecnología.

⚡ Blockchain regulada vs. otras infraestructuras. ¿Qué ventajas ofrece realmente y cuándo tiene sentido utilizarla?

🏦 Empresas e instituciones. ¿Qué necesitan para adoptar Blockchain con confianza y seguridad jurídica?

🪙 Tokenización y nuevos modelos de negocio. ¿Qué oportunidades aparecen para sectores como finanzas, inmobiliario, energía o industria?

🚀 Casos de uso reales. ¿Qué están construyendo las empresas y qué barreras encuentran para llevar sus proyectos a producción?

🤝 Talento y oportunidades. ¿Cómo conectar a las empresas que necesitan soluciones con los builders capaces de desarrollarlas?

No queremos únicamente escuchar presentaciones.

Queremos generar debate, compartir experiencias y descubrir qué podemos construir juntos

🚀 DEL DEBATE A LA CONSTRUCCIÓN

Con Bit2Me como desafío número 1 de SuperPioneros, seguimos impulsando una Comunidad de más de 80.000 innovadores que conecta talento, empresas, instituciones e inversores alrededor de la IA, Blockchain, Web3 y las tecnologías emergentes.

A través de nuestros desafíos 444, queremos ayudar a que las empresas encuentren dentro de la Comunidad los recursos, conocimientos y conexiones necesarios para avanzar hacia sus objetivos durante los próximos cuatro meses.

Y este encuentro representa una oportunidad para conectar infraestructuras como ISBE con empresas que tienen necesidades reales y builders que quieren construir soluciones.

Porque el futuro de Blockchain no dependerá únicamente de la tecnología.

Dependerá de los problemas que seamos capaces de resolver con ella.

name: SC Ventures Lab Crawl Panel 4: Policy Rewiring: When AI Moves Money
description:
About Event AI agents are no longer just recommending payments. With stablecoins and programmable rails, they can initiate and settle them too. That raises questions existing rules weren't written for. What should an agent be allowed to do on its own, when does a human need to approve, and who is accountable when something goes wrong? This session brings together banking, blockchain and regulatory perspectives to look at the permissions, oversight and safeguards needed before agents can be trusted to move real value. On th

:
-
- From recommend to execute: what changes when an AI agent can actually move money
- Delegated authority: spending limits, approved counterparties and the thresholds that should trigger human approval
- Know your agent: how agents are identified, authenticated and tied back to the person or business they act for
- When things go wrong: liability for errors, fraud or a compromised agent, and what happens when a stablecoin transaction can't be reversed
- Compliance by design: building sanctions screening, AML checks and audit trails into the transaction itself
- Are current rules fit for purpose, or does agentic finance need a new rulebook? Speakers:
- Rohan Juneja, Product Director, Digital Assets, Standard Chartered Bank
- Aishwary Gupta, Global Head of Business, Polygon
- Grace Chong, Head, Financial Services Regulation, Drew & Napier

name: Digital Assets Developments & Opportunities
description:
Two-Part Programme for Private Bankers and Family Office Practitioners in Asia Format: Two sessions of 90 minutes each The programme moves from "what's changing" to "what to do about it." Singapore and Hong Kong are the anchors, as the main booking centres and family office hubs for this audience, with Japan, the Gulf and other markets brought in where they matter to Asian clients

Part 1: The Global Tokenisation Landscape Title: From Pilot to Production: Markets, Infrastructure and Regulation in 2026 and beyond Tokenisation is moving from pilot projects into regulated commercial activity across several jurisdictions, marking an important inflection point for digital assets in 2026. With Singapore and Hong Kong serving as key financial and family office hubs in Asia, developments in tokenised real-world assets, stablecoins and financial market infrastructure are creating new opportunities and considerations for financial institutions, private bankers, family offices and investors. RHTLaw Asia invites you to join our industry and legal experts as we examine the global tokenisation landscape, focusing on the transition from experimentation to commercial implementation, and the regulatory, market and legal developments shaping its future

Key Discussion Topics 1. Global Policy Developments: The Industry View An examination of regulatory and policy developments across the United States, Singapore, Hong Kong and the UAE, including stablecoin legislation, tokenised securities and the growing need for cross-border regulatory recognition and interoperable standards. 2. Market and Infrastructure Reality Check A closer look at the rise of tokenised securities and institutional products, including tokenised investment funds and private credit. The discussion will examine infrastructure choices, public versus permissioned blockchains, settlement systems, interoperability risks and the liquidity challenges facing tokenised private assets. 3. Legal Implications for Investors Tokenisation does not change the underlying legal character of an asset. We will examine the distinction between tokens representing direct ownership rights and synthetic exposure, together with the legal considerations and potential risks for issuers and investors. 4. Panel Discussion and Q&A An interactive discussion bringing together industry and legal perspectives on the opportunities and challenges of tokenisation, and what these developments mean for the future of digital assets in Asia

Coming Up: Part 2. Tokenised Assets: The Investor's Playbook From Insight to Action: Access, Ownership, Risk and Legacy 3 December 2026 | 3:00 pm. 5:00 pm Building on the global developments covered in Part 1, the second session will focus on how private investors and family offices can participate in tokenised assets, including product structures, custody arrangements, investor protection, legal ownership, tax considerations and succession planning. From understanding what's changing to exploring what to do about it. We look forward to welcoming you.

ブロックチェーンを活用した金融サービスは、BitcoinやEthereumの登場を経て、DEX、レンディング、ステーブルコイン、デリバティブなど、さまざまな領域へと発展してきました。特に2020年のDeFi Summer以降、スマートコントラクトによる金融機能の実装が急速に進み、従来の金融機関や中央集権的な取引所を介さない、新しい金融市場の可能性が示されてきました。 https://www.neweconomy.jp/features/wbh ---- The “Web3 Business Hub (WBH)”, a corporate-focused Web3 community jointly operated by Atarashii Keizai and KudasaiJP, hosts monthly seminars designed to provide practical insights for advancing Web3 business initiatives. The theme for October is “Hyperliquid and the History of Onchain Finance” Blockchain-based financial services have evolved significantly since the emergence of Bitcoin and Ethereum, expanding into various areas such as decentralized exchanges (DEXs), lending, stablecoins, and derivatives. In particular, since DeFi Summer in 2020, the rapid development of smart contract-based financial applications has demonstrated the potential for new financial markets that operate without relying on traditional financial intermediaries or centralized exchanges. One of the projects representing this evolution is Hyperliquid, which has gained significant attention through its focus on on-chain derivatives trading. Built on its own Layer 1 blockchain, Hyperliquid combines high-speed transaction processing with an on-chain order book, offering a trading experience comparable to that of centralized exchanges (CEXs) while exploring new possibilities for decentralized finance. With the expansion of its ecosystem through HyperEVM, Hyperliquid is also evolving beyond a trading platform into a broader on-chain financial ecosystem. At the same time, the development of on-chain finance continues to face challenges, including liquidity, price discovery, security, decentralization, governance, and regulatory compliance. What has DeFi achieved throughout its history, and what challenges remain unresolved? To what extent can emerging platforms such as Hyperliquid transform traditional financial markets and the role of cryptocurrency exchanges? For this edition of Web3 Business Hub, we will explore the history of on-chain finance, from the early days of DeFi and DeFi Summer to the evolution of DEXs and on-chain derivatives, culminating in the rise of Hyperliquid. We will also examine Hyperliquid's architecture, the factors behind its growth, how it differs from traditional financial services, and the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead. How much of the financial system can ultimately move on-chain? Through the lens of Hyperliquid, we will explore the current state and future potential of on-chain finance, as well as the new opportunities it may create for financial institutions, Web3 businesses, and enterprises. Intro This year's Singapore FinTech Festival looks at the forces rewiring global finance. Payments is where that rewiring is most visible: AI agents are starting to spend real money, more of it settles in stablecoins, and the rails are arriving faster than the controls. REWIRED brings together the people building and running payments to work out what comes next:
- Who authorises an agent to pay?
- What stops the payment when the agent is compromised?
- Where does the margin sit when software pays software? Speakers Featuring speakers from AWS, Visa, Mastercard, BVNK, BlockSec, FXC Intelligence, Sunrate and Cobo You make the calls
- Run the incident. MAS's SAFR framework proposes that no agent action executes until it has been declared, authorised and assessed. Test that idea on a live case: an agent with payment authority has been manipulated and transfers are queued. Vote on what stops the money, then put the panel on the spot.
- Pick the rails. Card networks are piloting agent checkout across APAC, and Visa already settles in stablecoins at a US$7 billion annualised run rate. Cards, stablecoins or both: argue who owns checkout when the buyer is software.
- Settle the bank question. Everyone agrees you need a bank to cash out. Beyond that, decide whether banks still own anything when agents pay: programmable money, accountability for the agent, or 24/7 settlement. Ask in English or Chinese on Slido at any time.

name: Quantum Security for Digital Assets
description:
As quantum computing accelerates toward cryptographically relevant milestones, the digital asset ecosystem faces an architectural reckoning. Public blockchains like Ethereum are charting multi-year post-quantum cryptography (PQC) roadmaps and custody providers are testing PQC in practice, but protecting distributed ledgers, critical infrastructure and cross-border digital economies requires coordinated action across industry, regulators and government agencies. This afternoon brings them into one room. We open with Project Eagle, a live PQC pilot co-led by Safeheron and the Responsible Fintech Institute, in which banks and regulators across multiple jurisdictions test quantum-resistant multi-party computation (MPC) signing on a public testnet. A panel of leaders from law, law enforcement technology, smart-city jurisdictions and quantum security then examines signature scheme migration, systemic risks to custody and key management, and the public-private standards needed before Q-Day. We close with Ethereum's post-quantum roadmap and what it means for institutions, followed by networking.

name: Designing Trust in the Digital Economy
description:
## Introduction As AI reshapes how we build, create, and transact, trust has become the currency that matters most.

Join us for an event on using AI to build trust across the new money era, content, and AI itself with keynotes, a hands-on AI skills challenge, and networking to wrap up the evenin

: Keynote talks from industry voices Live Q&A with speakers Community networkin

Speakers Peter Zheng is Head of Design at OKX, where his team designs the products more than 120 million customers use to trade, pay and save. Over 20 years, his career has taken him from East to West, through agencies including W+K, TBWA\Media Arts Lab and Ogilvy, and in-house at Google, Samsung and Meta. Working across cultures has taught him that good ideas start with listening. As AI changes how products get made, he is helping his team move from designing screens to designing systems, with people at the center. Topic Intro: More of our financial lives now happen on a phone, at any hour, and soon with AI doing some of the work for us. None of that matters if people don't feel safe enough to use it. Crypto gave us new ways to prove things. Anyone can check a transaction on a blockchain, and exchanges publish reports showing they hold customers' funds. Yet people still hesitate before they hit "confirm." Proof and protection are different things, and design has to close the distance between them. In this session, Peter shares how OKX designs for trust, from showing people how they're protected to helping them understand what they're agreeing to before it's final. He'll also look at what changes when we start handing some of those decisions to an AI agent. Pearly Tan is Content Systems Director at OKX, where she is leading the shift from content design as a service to content as a scalable system for global digital products. She previously led Global Content Design at OKX and led the build of award-winning experiences across Meta Reality Labs, TikTok Shop and Bank of Singapore. Topic intro: As digital products expand, users face more opportunities, choices and information. They also face more uncertainty, emotion and risk. Trust must be built throughout the experience, especially when people are deciding whether to explore, act, or ask for help. Doing this at scale requires a shift from relying on specialists for every decision to building systems that make trustworthy choices easier across the organisation. This session explores how content systems can: Give users the information they need, when they need it Build trust with transparency that is relevant and proportionate Direct expertise to moments where uncertainty carries real consequences Help every team make sound, responsible decisions at scale Pearly will discuss OKX's content transformation and how AI-enabled systems can help more people become responsible trust builders. Ben Bowes is the Director of Product Design at Open Government Products (OGP), where he helps teams make government products effective, enjoyable and worthy of people's trust. He thinks public service is where the best designers belong, making everyday life better for the people around them. As AI reshapes how we build and create, Ben believes people must remain at the heart of what we design and why. Topic intro: When AI can make almost anything look and sound convincing, how do we know what's real and who to trust? From everyday encounters to government services, design shapes how trust is built, tested and sometimes exploited. With so much uncertainty, how can public institutions earn our trust? Maybe a little doubt is part of what makes trust possible

Who should attend Designers who are curious about how AI is reshaping trust in technolog

description:
Wie is Satoshi Nakamoto? Het is een van de grootste onopgeloste raadsels van onze tijd, en op zaterdag 21 november duiken we er samen in. De Dutch Bitcoin Embassy nodigt je uit voor een besloten vertoning van Finding Satoshi in Flora Filmtheater in Den Haag, met popcorn bij de film en een borrel na afloop

Over de film Finding Satoshi (2026) volgt onderzoeksjournalist William D. Cohan en privédetective Tyler Maroney tijdens een forensisch onderzoek van vier jaar naar de herkomst van Bitcoin. Onderweg spreken ze mensen uit het hart van de sector, onder wie Michael Saylor en Joseph Lubin. De film gaat net zo goed over de ideeën achter Bitcoin als over de vraag wie het heeft bedacht. Regie: Matthew Miele en Tucker Tooley - 101 minuten - Engels gesproke

DeFi와 트레이딩을 넘어, 블록체인이 우리의 일상 속으로 들어오는 새로운 방식을 STEPUP과 함께 만나보세요.

## 実用の先へ、安全とともに。

## ーAI・デジタルアセット・サイバーセキュリティの現在地ー

AIやデジタルアセットの活用が加速する中、テクノロジーの進化を支える「サイバーセキュリティ」の重要性が改めて問われています。

利便性や効率性、新たなビジネス機会を追求する一方で、サイバーリスクへの対応、デジタル資産の保護、そして社会やユーザーからの信頼をどのように確保していくのか。これらは、テクノロジーを実社会で活用していくうえで避けては通れないテーマです。

本イベントでは、AIとデジタルアセットの最前線を見据え、サイバーセキュリティを取り巻く現状や課題、今後求められる考え方について議論します。

技術の進化を一過性のトレンドで終わらせず、安全で持続可能な活用へ。

そのために必要な視点を共有する機会をお届けします。

◾イベント概要

• 主催: Gate Japan株式会社
• 共催: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• 日時：11月24日(火)18:00-20:30 （開場は17:45）

• 完全招待制 (事前登録および当日に本人確認あり)
• 運営ポリシー: 発言内容の引用は可能ですが、発言者及び所属組織を特定できる形での引用は禁止します。録画・録音・ライブ配信は行いません。

◾共催企業について

Amazon Web Services（AWS）は、世界で最も包括的かつ幅広く採用されているクラウドサービスです。世界有数の取引所、ブロックチェーンプロトコル、Web3分野の開発者から信頼され、安全性、拡張性、可用性に優れたインフラストラクチャを提供しています。

ノードのホスティングやブロックチェーンデータの管理から、生成AIや自律型AIエージェントまで、AWSはWeb3分野のイノベーターが開発を加速し、グローバルに事業を拡大するとともに、最高水準のセキュリティおよびコンプライアンス基準を満たせるよう支援しています。

厳選したワインをはじめ、Thanksgiving Dayにちなんだローストチキンや彩り豊かなオードブルなど、さまざまなお料理やお飲み物をご用意いたします。

美味しいお食事とともに、登壇者や参加者の皆さまと交流を深め、新たなつながりやビジネスの可能性が生まれるひとときをお楽しみください。

## Beyond Practical Applications, Together with Security.

## ーThe State of AI, Digital Assets, and Securityー

As the adoption of AI and digital assets continues to accelerate, the importance of security as a foundation for technological progress is coming increasingly into focus.

While businesses pursue greater convenience, efficiency, and new opportunities, critical questions remain: How can we address evolving cyber risks, safeguard digital assets, and maintain the trust of society and users? These are essential challenges that cannot be overlooked as emerging technologies become part of our everyday lives and business operations.

In this event, we will explore the forefront of AI and digital assets, examining the current security landscape, the challenges we face, and the perspectives needed to navigate the future.

Moving beyond technological trends toward safe and sustainable adoption.

Join us as we share insights and perspectives on what it takes to build a more secure digital future.

Ideas, conexiones y oportunidades alrededor de una mesa

Martes 24 de noviembre - 20:00-22:00 h Madrid - Almagro Plazas limitadas - Acceso bajo aprobación

¿Qué ocurre cuando reunimos alrededor de una mesa a personas que están construyendo el futuro de la Inteligencia Artificial, Blockchain y Cripto?

El próximo 24 de noviembre organizamos una nueva experiencia presencial de SuperPioneros en Madrid: una cena de fundadores, emprendedores y builders que están desarrollando ideas, proyectos y empresas alrededor de las tecnologías disruptivas.

Esta vez cambiamos el escenario.

Sin escenario, sin ponencias y sin presentaciones comerciales.

Solo una mesa, buenas conversaciones y personas con ganas de construir.

## ¿CÓMO FUNCIONARÁ?

Queremos que todos los participantes tengan la oportunidad de conocerse y descubrir posibles sinergias.

Conoce a los demás fundadores. Cada participante compartirá brevemente quién es, qué está construyendo y qué necesita para avanzar.

Descubre proyectos e ideas. Conoceremos iniciativas relacionadas con IA, Blockchain, Cripto y otras tecnologías emergentes.

Encuentra oportunidades. Buscaremos conexiones entre talento, proyectos, empresas e inversores que puedan ayudarse mutuamente.

Conecta con los VIP de SuperPioneros. Participarán miembros de nuestra Comunidad que ya están impulsando sus propios desafíos y construyendo nuevas soluciones.

## ¿A QUIÉN VA DIRIGIDA?

A fundadores, emprendedores, profesionales e inversores interesados en participar activamente en el ecosistema de innovación.

Especialmente a quienes:

- Están construyendo una startup o desarrollando una idea.
- Trabajan en proyectos de Inteligencia Artificial, Blockchain o Cripto.
- Buscan talento, colaboradores, clientes o socios.
- Quieren conocer a otros fundadores y compartir experiencias.
- Forman parte de SuperPioneros y desean acelerar sus desafíos.

No importa tanto el tamaño de tu proyecto como tus ganas de construir y colaborar.

## UNA CENA, MUCHAS OPORTUNIDADES

En SuperPioneros creemos que las mejores conexiones aparecen cuando compartimos nuestros desafíos con las personas adecuadas.

Por eso organizamos este encuentro en un formato reducido, donde todos puedan conversar y participar.

Queremos que cada asistente termine la cena habiendo conocido a nuevas personas y descubierto al menos una oportunidad para avanzar en su proyecto.

## INSCRIPCIONES

Miembros VIP SuperPioneros: 35 €

No miembros: 55 €

Las plazas son muy limitadas y todas las solicitudes estarán sujetas a aprobación, buscando reunir perfiles complementarios y favorecer las oportunidades de colaboración.

name: WhitePaper Reading Taipei #5 - Road to Hegota Upgrade
description:
🇹🇼 Whitepaper Reading Club 台北・第五場來了!

之前我們讀過 EF Mandate,聊「抗審查」為什麼是以太坊的底線。這次我們把鏡頭拉近到協議本身:接下來的升級,以太坊打算怎麼重新設計「誰來出塊」

主題:從 ePBS 到 FOCIL:以太坊前進 Hegota 之路

為什麼是現在: 今天以太坊大多數區塊,是透過鏈下 relay 交給少數 builder 打包的。

即將到來的 Glamsterdam 升級,主角是 ePBS(EIP-7732):把 proposer 和 builder 之間的交接直接寫進協議,不再需要信任中間的 relay。

下一個升級 Hegotá,主角則是 FOCIL(EIP-7805):由驗證者委員會指定「必須上鏈」的交易,builder 不照做,區塊就拿不到支持。EF 已把它列為 must ship,寧可延後整個升級也不拿掉。

一個把 builder 收進協議,一個限制 builder 不能審查。這晚,我們把兩者放在一起讀。

Discussion Lead:Nic Lin Protocol Researcher | Smart Contract Engineer 專注 L2、MEV 與安全協議設計,參與過帳戶抽象、Rollup、MEV aware DEX 等以太坊核心基礎設施,持續發表研究並參與開源工具開發,也常在全球以太坊大會分享。目前正在探索 universal account、L1/L2 互通性,以及抗審查。

這晚我們會一起辯論:

ePBS 拿掉了對 relay 的信任,但 MEV 和 builder 集中的問題真的解決了嗎?還是只是換個地方集中? ePBS 和 FOCIL 怎麼搭配?如果只有其中一個,以太坊會長什麼樣子? 當初 ePBS 先上、FOCIL 排到下一輪,這個先後順序合理嗎? Hegotá 另一個主角 Frame Transactions 把帳戶抽象寫進協議,對錢包和用戶體驗意味著什麼? 終極問題:協議該把多少權力從 builder 手上拿回來?抗審查值得讓整個 roadmap 等它嗎?

活動流程

活動前會先發研究資料,讓大家提前閱讀!現場也會提供整理好的 1 至 2 頁 summary,幫你快速抓住重點!

當天大家會圍坐成一圈,由 moderator 帶大家討論~不過更多的學習、洞見與精華,往往是在彼此交流的過程中迸出來的,那才是最好玩的部分!

特別感謝 White Paper Reading Club、台北以太坊社群協助舉辦,以及 imToken 提供場地支持

誠摯邀請大家一起來這場 nerdy night

什麼是 Whitepaper Reading Club(WPRC)? 一個聚集 800+ builders、engineers、researchers 的全球社群,橫跨 Singapore、Kuala Lumpur、San Francisco、Lagos、Bangkok、New York,每月聚在一起,圓桌式硬啃最新的 blockchain 項目和研究論文!

WPRC 獨立於任何生態,三年來活動完全由會員支持,已主持超過 100 場閱讀會。

name: Whitepaper Reading Club: Hyperliquid - Technical Unboxing
description:
Most decentralized exchanges rely on Automated Market Makers (AMMs) as traditional central limit order books (CLOBs) are difficult & expensive to run on-chain (high gas fees, slow block times), and latency make real-time order matching impractical on general-purpose blockchains.

We disucss how Hyperliquid solves these architectural bottlenecks from the ground up. We'll explore its:

- Custom Layer-1 design, the HyperBFT consensus mechanism
- How it achieves CEX-level throughput and sub-second finality without sacrificing self-custody
- The mechanics behind its protocol-native liquidity vaults (HLP).

Whether you're a DeFi builder, trader, or systems enthusiast, join us for a deep dive into the engineering trade-offs making fully on-chain order books possible.

Paper / source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kpeQYXjkeouIyhzwbsgggqatEXT0MV7R8VCLmLmmxlI/edit?usp=sharing

## Format

- Short introduction and context setting to start.
- A short walkthrough of the paper and its key ideas.
- Questions and discussion grounded in the original source.
- Moderator-led discussion with no promotions.

## Session Guides - David Kurniawan (Sr. Product Manager D3Labs)

A Senior Product Manager at D3 Labs, where he oversees the company's blockchain and its connections to other networks. He previously led product at Delman and was the head of product. He holds an MBA from INSEAD, a master's in information systems management from Carnegie Mellon University, and a bachelor's in mechatronics engineering from Swiss German University.

## About Whitepaper Reading Club

We are a community of founders, researchers, and builders across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Bangkok, New York, Lagos, Taipei, and Hong Kong. We meet in person every month to read, discuss, and pressure-test the latest blockchain papers, protocols, and technical ideas.

Learn more: Website (https://wprc.club) - Summaries (https://www.wprc.club/papers) - Calendar (https://luma.com/whitepaper)

We create detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and have held 80+ sessions since June 2023, covering Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, EIPs, the Bitcoin ecosystem, and AI x Crypto. We are ecosystem-agnostic, not for profit, and focused on projects with technical, product, or social innovation.

name: Whitepaper Reading Club: Native Privacy on BNB Chain
description:
BNB Chain is developing a next-generation, high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 designed for high-frequency trading, real-time payments, privacy, and AI agents.

Goal: 100,000+ TPS, sub-second finality, and approximately 20ms transaction pre-confirmation, the new architecture aims to push blockchain performance closer to centralized systems while preserving on-chain execution.

What We'll Discuss: Privacy through native shielded transactions using zero-knowledge proofs. We'll explore the proposed architecture, challenge its design decisions, and discuss its potential implications for the broader blockchain ecosystem.

Components of the New L1 chain:

- Architecture & Consensus: Enhanced Parlia, BLS fast finality, and asynchronous execution.
- Performance: Parallel EVM execution, 200ms block intervals, and LtHash-based storage.
- Transaction Ordering: Pre-confirmations, direct-to-proposer transaction routing, and Multi-Lane reserved capacity.
- Native Account Abstraction: Gas sponsorship, session keys, passkeys, and transaction batching.
- The Bigger Picture: Why build another L1 instead of scaling BSC? What are the technical trade-offs?

Who Should Join? Everyone is welcome, from curious beginners to experienced Web3 developers. No presentation required, just bring your curiosity, questions, and perspectives!

Reading Material:

- Main Docs: https://docs.bnbchain.org/newl1/
- Forum: https://forum.bnbchain.org/t/introducing-the-new-l1-native-privacy-layer/5481

## Format

- Short introduction and context setting to start.
- A short walkthrough of the paper and its key ideas.
- Questions and discussion grounded in the original source.
- Moderator-led discussion with no promotions.

## Session Guides:

Sky is a blockchain tech founder and BNB Chain DevRel Ambassador based in Kuala Lumpur.

He co-founded YOLO Protocol, supported by Uniswap and Base, and GIVE Protocol, supported by Bybit's Blockchain for Good Alliance. He is currently building PAYtience, a Solana-based trading platform.

He also leads the Whitepaper Nerd Club, bringing curious minds together to explore blockchain ideas. Always excited to meet fellow nerds, share knowledge, and make new friends. Come nerd out with us!

## BNB Hackathon

There's also the BNB Chain Hackathon happening on Nov 25-27 and Demo Night (Nov 27), with something for everyone: (i) Developers: Build a project from scratch and bring your ideas to life. (ii) Founders: Pitch your project to VCs and connect with potential investors. (iii) Web3 enthusiasts: Discover emerging projects and explore the latest innovations.

## BNB Chain

Decentralized blockchain ecosystem designed for high-speed, low-cost Web3 applications. Originally launched by Binance, it operates as a multi-chain network powered by its native BNB token.

## About Whitepaper Reading Club

We are a community of founders, researchers, and builders across Singapore, Malaysia, San Francisco, Bangkok, New York, Lagos, Taipei, and Hong Kong. We meet in person every month to read, discuss, and pressure-test the latest blockchain papers, protocols, and technical ideas.

Learn more: Website (https://wprc.club) - Summaries (https://www.wprc.club/papers) - Calendar (https://luma.com/whitepaper)

We create detailed, easy-to-understand summaries for each paper and have held 80+ sessions since June 2023, covering Account Abstraction, Parallel Chains, EIPs, the Bitcoin ecosystem, and AI x Crypto. We are ecosystem-agnostic, not for profit, and focused on projects with technical, product, or social innovation.

description:
## Web3 보안 전문팀 OtterSec이 서울에 옵니다!

OtterSec은 Web3 보안 분야에서 상당한 기술적 깊이와 독보적인 연구 역량을 보여주고 있는 팀입니다. Solana 생태계의 핵심 인프라인 Anchor v2부터 Prop AMM과 같은 프로토콜의 리버스 엔지니어링, 실제 시스템에서의 취약점 발견까지, 기존의 접근 방식에 머무르지 않고 다양한 영역에서 새로운 기술적 시도를 이어가고 있습니다.

이번에는 그 OtterSec 팀을 서울에서 직접 만나볼 수 있는 자리를 마련했습니다. 팀이 최근 어떤 연구를 진행하고 있는지, 어떤 흥미로운 문제들을 파고들고 있는지, AI를 보안 연구와 감사에 어떻게 접목하고 있는지, 그리고 AI가 앞으로 Web3 보안의 방향을 어떻게 바꿔갈지 직접 들어볼 수 있습니다. 평소 관심 있게 지켜봤던 분들은 물론, 새로운 기술과 연구에 관심 있는 분들에게도 좋은 기회가 될 것 같습니다.

## 1. Presentations & Speakers

이번 행사에는 Zcash 취약점 제보로 7자리 수 규모의 버그 바운티를 받은 OtterSec의 한국인 보안 연구원 GSS1(강상수)을 비롯해 OtterSec의 다른 보안 연구원들이 발표자로 참여합니다.

주요 발표 주제는 다음과 같습니다.

• 실제 취약점 발견 사례와 보안 연구 과정
• 프로토콜 리버스 엔지니어링과 새로운 감사 기법
• OtterSec이 현재 연구하고 개발 중인 기술과 프로젝트
• Web3 보안의 새로운 도전 과제와 앞으로의 방향

각 발표 후에는 Q&A 시간이 이어집니다. 발표는 영어로 진행됩니다.

## 2. Schedule

November 26, 2026 (Thu.) | 18:30–22:00

• 18:30–19:00 — 참가자 등록 및 입장
• 19:00–20:30 — 기술 발표 및 Q&A (Details TBA)
• 20:30–22:00 — OtterSec 팀과의 네트워킹

## 3. Who Should Attend?

스마트 컨트랙트 개발자, 보안 연구자, 감사 전문가, 프로토콜 엔지니어 등 Web3 보안에 관심 있는 분들이라면 누구나 환영합니다.

특히 실제 취약점 분석이나 리버스 엔지니어링에 관심이 있거나, 다른 보안 연구자들과 기술적인 이야기를 나누고 싶은 분들에게 좋은 기회가 될 것입니다.

발표를 듣는 것뿐 아니라 OtterSec 팀원들과 직접 이야기를 나누고, 국내 개발자 및 보안 연구자들과 교류하는 시간도 가져보세요.

## OtterSec is coming to Seoul!

OtterSec has built a reputation for technically ambitious work at the forefront of Web3 security research. From its work on core Solana infrastructure such as Anchor v2 to reverse engineering protocols like Prop AMMs and uncovering vulnerabilities in live systems, the team is constantly exploring new approaches to understanding and securing blockchain infrastructure.

We're bringing the OtterSec team to Seoul for an evening of technical talks and conversations. Hear directly from the team about what they've been working on, the interesting problems they're tackling, how they're incorporating AI into their security research and auditing workflows, and how they see AI shaping the future of Web3 security. Whether you've been following their work or are simply curious about what's happening at the cutting edge of blockchain security, we'd love to have you join us.

## 1. Presentations & Speakers

Joining us will be GSS1, the Korean OtterSec auditor behind a seven-figure Zcash bug bounty, alongside other OtterSec auditors.

Topics will include:

• Interesting vulnerability discoveries and real-world security research
• Protocol reverse engineering and novel auditing techniques
• What the OtterSec team has been researching and building
• Emerging challenges and directions in Web3 security

Presentations will be followed by an open Q&A. Talks will be conducted in English.

Whether you're a security researcher, smart contract auditor, blockchain developer, protocol engineer, or simply interested in how Web3 systems work under the hood, you're welcome to join.

If you're interested in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, protocol security, or meeting others working in the space, this is a good opportunity to exchange ideas and get to know the people behind the research.

Come for the talks, stay for the conversations. Meet the OtterSec team and connect with Seoul's blockchain security community.

name: Agentic Finance x AI Security — Bangkok Side Event
description:
Event Overview

As autonomous agents move from demos to holding keys, routing capital, and settling on-chain, two questions decide who wins: what can agents actually do with money, and how do we keep them — and the rails beneath them — safe. Agentic finance is moving fast, but the infrastructure for agent-held assets, agent-to-agent payments, and verifiable agent behavior is still being built, and the security assumptions behind it are being tested in real time.

This side event brings both sides of that question onto one stage. We convene the builders defining agentic finance and the teams securing it — for an opening keynote, two moderated panels on Agentic Finance and AI Security, and a closing Braindates session — as a Binance Blockchain Week Bangkok 2026 side event.

Agenda

13:30 - 14:00 Registration + Welcome Drinks

14:00 - 14:10 Keynote 1: dLife

14:10 - 14:20 Keynote 2: Junto

14:20 - 15:00 Panel Discussion 1: Agentic Finance

15:00 - 15:10 Break

15:10 - 15:50 Panel Discussion 2: AI Security

15:50 - 17:00 Braindates & Networking

Welcome drinks will be provided.

Organizers Introduction
Host

Junto
Junto is an AI-first trading terminal that brings US-stock perpetuals, crypto, meme scanning, and paper agents into one conversational workspace. It is built for traders who want to turn a market idea into a rule, backtest it, and see what actually happened — with every decision, order, and fill auditable.

dp.life (https://dp.life)
dp.life (https://dp.life) is a Web3 super app that blends a decentralized wallet, discover, AI analysis, and social into one identity, connected to the compliant world through a centralized account system. It brings on-chain and off-chain life together, lowering the barrier for everyday users to enter Web3.

Profitech Securities
Profitech Securities Limited is a Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission licensed corporation (CE No. BOA307), licensed for Type 1, 4, 6, and 9 regulated activities. It connects traditional capital markets with the digital asset economy, bringing regulated-market discipline to the agentic finance conversation.

Co-Host

Pharos
Pharos is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built as global infrastructure for real-world assets, founded by former Ant Group blockchain executives. Its modular, full-stack parallel architecture targets 30,000 TPS with sub-second finality, serving institutions bringing financial assets onchain and the AI agents that hold and move them.

Blockin Ventures
Blockin Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on blockchain and Web3, backing early-stage teams building the infrastructure and applications of the onchain economy. It supports founders from inception with capital, network, and hands-on guidance.

ZeroDrift
ZeroDrift is building AI offensive security for enterprise software. Our AI agents run penetration tests and code reviews the way a real attacker would, and our security researchers verify every finding and help teams ship the fix. ZeroDrift has published CVEs in Apple, Google and Microsoft software, works with partners including Infini, BNB Chain, Sign and Flap, and is backed by YZi Labs.

Roostoo
Roostoo is building autonomous AI trading agents. Every agent is tested in live paper-trading competitions on our platform, where it builds a verifiable track record, and users can then select the agents they trust to deploy real capital on decentralized exchanges. Roostoo is backed by YZi Labs.

Andes Ventures
Andes Ventures is a Web3 venture capital firm and accelerator focused on blockchain infrastructure and related fields, having invested in dozens of projects across Europe and the United States. It backs world-class teams driving sustainable and inclusive innovation across consensus, middleware, DeFi, gaming, and social.

ACPX
ACPX is a Web3 project building at the intersection of digital assets and onchain infrastructure. It works with builders across the ecosystem to bring new products and experiences to users in the agentic finance era.

dLife
dLife is an AI4Sci project incubated by BNB Chain's MVB10. We use cryptography and smart contracts to protect and utilize personal biological data, return genome ownership to individuals, and build decentralized longevity infrastructure, with the tools the AI era demands for data security and privacy.

Techub News
Techub News is a Hong Kong-based technology media outlet covering AI, Web3, and the cross-border digital economy, with a bilingual Chinese-English newsroom and editorial teams across Asia. It brings a Hong Kong perspective on the fast-moving Web3 landscape to builders, investors, and everyday readers across the region.

About Event

​Solana Student Bootcampは、AIを活用しながら、自分のアイデアをSolanaブロックチェーン上のプロダクトとして形にしていく、学生向け・全4回の実践プログラムです。

​「AIを使って、自分でも何かつくってみたい」「ブロックチェーンが、実際にどんな場面で使われているのか知りたい」その興味を、開発の第一歩につなげます。

​いま注目されている領域を知り、実際に手を動かすことで、技術への理解を深めていきます。

​AIとブロックチェーンの今を、つくりながら学ぶ

​AIが目覚ましく進化する今、ブロックチェーンの活用やプロダクト開発は、どのように変わっているのでしょうか。

​本プログラムでは、業界で注目されている領域や実際の活用について学びながら、Solana上での開発に取り組みます。

​学んだことを、自分のアイデアで試してみる。AIを活用して実装し、動きを確かめ、改善する。講義と開発を行き来しながら、「知っている」を「つくれる」へと近づけていきます。

​全4回の実践プログラムを通じて目指すのは、自分のアイデアをプロダクトとして開発する力を身につけること。授業や独学で得た知識も、まだ形になっていない発想も、実際に動くものへとつなげていきましょう。

​現場で活躍する人の視点に触れる

​実際の現場で活躍する方々を、外部講師としてお招きする予定です。技術の説明だけでなく、現場で何に取り組み、どのようにプロダクトをつくっているのか。その視点に触れることも、自分がつくりたいものを考えるヒントになります。

name: SuiHub Lagos: The Stable Side of Sui with Zynta
description:
Moving money across borders in Africa remains one of the hardest engineering and operational challenges in fintech. From navigating complex currency corridors to handling multi-jurisdictional compliance, building reliable payment systems requires solid rails and regulatory compliance.

Join Zynta and Sui for an intensive, 2.5-hour hands-on developer session in Lagos. We will explore how stablecoin infrastructure, multi-chain settlement rails, and unified API endpoints combine to power seamless cross-border transactions across Africa, Europe, and beyond.

Whether you are building a neobank, an enterprise payout platform, or an on/off-ramp product, this session will show you how to move from sign-up to your first live API call on production-grade payment infrastructure.

## What You Will Learn

- Unified Infrastructure: How Zynta brings payment rails, merchant tools, and institutional liquidity into a single API integration.
- On-Chain Settlement on Sui: How to leverage Sui's speed and low transaction costs for stablecoin settlement while Zynta handles fiat edges and compliance.
- Licensing as a Moat: Why inheriting fully regulated compliance structures lets developers build faster without regulatory friction.
- Go-To-Market Across Africa: Actionable strategies for selling tech across diverse African markets - including navigating regional monetary zones like WAEMU (XOF) and CEMAC (XAF).

## What to Bring

- Your Laptop & Charger: You will be writing code, testing API endpoints, and taking part in the live build challenge.
- An Idea or Project: Bring questions about payment flows you are currently designing or scaling.
Speakers

Peace Audu-Ukpoju - Chief Product Officer at Zynta Peace leads product strategy, partnerships and regulatory work, and helps build the rails businesses use to move money across Africa and beyond. Before Zynta, she worked on payments at Relm, a cross-border crypto and fiat platform, and led product teams at companies in Lagos and Abuja.

Agbakwuru Oluchi, Head of Engineering at Zynta Oluchi leads engineering at Zynta and works with businesses as a solutions engineer to help them integrate Zynta's payment rails, from the first API call to live production. She focuses on building reliable cross-border infrastructure that combines stablecoin settlement with fiat payouts across Africa and beyond

Elohor Lauretta Isiakpere, Head of Sales-Nigeria at Zynta At Zynta, she helps businesses simplify cross-border payments with stablecoin infrastructure and is known for building trust with both C-suite and technical buyers, and showing businesses how better money flows turn into revenue. Before Zynta, she was Acting Head of Enterprise Accounts at Nomba (YC-W17), where she grew the enterprise customer base and scaled team productivity.

description:
## Is Your Bitcoin Safe in the Age of AI? / AI時代、あなたのBitcoinは安全ですか?

## A side event of Bitcoin Japan 2026 (https://btc-jpn.com/) / (https://btc-jpn.com/)Bitcoin Japan 2026 (https://btc-jpn.com/) のサイドイベント

Bitcoin Japan 2026 brought the Bitcoin world to Tokyo, but there were not many sessions in English. So Tokyo Bitcoin Base is opening its doors to everyone who wants to hear from international speakers and see presentations in English.

Don't speak English? You are just as welcome. All presentations will be translated into Japanese, so everyone can follow along. You're also free to come and go anytime, so feel free to join just for the sessions you're most interested in.

Hacks are changing the Bitcoin world. So what can we do about it? Three short talks, each followed by a panel, plus a fourth panel on Japan, with the builders on the front line: what really happened inside BTCPay Server, how decentralization can stop hacks before they happen, and how to protect your own keys with a DIY signer.

Speakers

Nicolas Dorier (https://x.com/NicolasDorier), Creator of BTCPay Server

Anna (https://x.com/annahhodl), CEO of Hodl

DIY Pacman (https://x.com/DIYbitcoin), DIY signer

Jonathan Underwood (https://x.com/junderwood4649), bitbank

Kishin (https://x.com/btc_dakara), Japan Bitcoin Industry

Joe Miyamoto (https://x.com/joemphilips), Developer

Brad, MC

## Program (13:00-17:00, doors open 12:45)

- Opening
- Nicolas Dorier LT: What happened at BTCPay Server,
- Panel 1: Security & Crisis
- Anna LT: Hodl and decentralization
- Panel 2: Centralized Exchanges
- DIY Pacman LT: DIY signer
- Panel 3: Hardware Wallets & Makers
- Panel 4: Security in Japan
- Networking

## Never been to TBB? Now's your chance

Tokyo Bitcoin Base is Tokyo's home for Bitcoiners. While you're here, take a look at:

- The event space, which you can book for your own meetups and events
- Shared offices and coworking spaces you can rent

During networking, the mic is open: feel free to present your own project to the room. Come for the talks, stay for the people, and leave knowing where Tokyo's Bitcoin community lives.

Ticket: Free

Tokyo Bitcoin Base, Yotsuya, Tokyo

English, with Japanese translation

Bitcoin Japan 2026では、英語で話す登壇者やセッションがあまりありませんでした。そこでTokyo Bitcoin Baseは、海外の登壇者の話を聞きたい方、英語のプレゼンテーションに触れたい方のために、会場を開くことにしました。

name: UniTour#3 - Garanti BBVA Kripto x Team1 Türkiye - Piri Reis Üniversitesi
description:
## Garanti BBVA Kripto ve Team1 Türkiye kampüsüne geliyor! UniTour#3, blockchain teknolojisini kampüslere taşımayı, öğrencileri Web3 dünyasıyla tanıştırmayı ve yeni nesil kariyer fırsatlarıyla onlara ilham vermeyi amaçlıyor. UniTour#3'ün 4. etkinliği PRÜ Blockchain Kulübü’nün desteğiyle Piri Reis Üniversitesi’nde gerçekleşecek. Garanti BBVA Kripto’nun (https://www.garantibbvakripto.com.tr/?utm_source=luma) dijital varlık vizyonunu yakından tanıyacak, kripto cüzdanlarıyla varlıklarınızı nasıl güvenle saklayabileceğinizi ve kolayca yönetebileceğinizi keşfedeceksiniz. Avalanche Cascade (https://go.team1.network/turkiye-cascade?utm_source=luma) ile Avalanche Ekosistemi’nin temellerini öğrenirken, Team1 Türkiye’nin (https://go.team1.network/turkiye?utm_source=luma) hem topluluk odaklı öğrencilere hem de geliştirici öğrencilere sunduğu fırsatları yakından inceleme şansı bulacaksınız. Etkinlik Akışı [Etkinliğin detaylı programı ve oturum saatleri çok yakında duyurulacaktır.] Etkinliğin sonunda katılımcılar, pizza ve içecekler eşliğinde keyifli bir networking (tanışma ve bağlantı kurma) oturumuna katılma fırsatı bulacak. Ayrıca defter, kalem, tişört veya çanta gibi çeşitli promosyon ürünleri küçük hatıralar olarak dağıtılacak

​ Garanti BBVA Kripto Garanti BBVA Kripto (https://www.garantibbvakripto.com.tr/?utm_source=luma), Türkiye’nin en büyük özel bankalarından biri olan Garanti BBVA’nın iştiraki olarak, kripto varlık hizmetleri sunmak amacıyla Mayıs 2023’te kurulmuştur. Temel hedefi, kripto dünyasına adım atan bireylere yüksek kaliteli ve kullanıcı odaklı bir deneyim sunmaktır. Sunduğu hizmetler arasında kripto varlık saklama ve alım-satım işlemleri ön plana çıkmaktadır

​ Team1 Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), Avalanche (https://www.avax.network/?utm_source=luma) ekosistemini büyütmeye odaklanan geliştiriciler, üreticiler, içerik oluşturucular, oyuncular ve topluluk liderlerinden oluşan küresel bir ağdır. 50'den fazla ülkede aktif olarak faaliyet gösteren Team1 (https://x.com/AvaxTeam1?utm_source=luma), yerel buluşmalar, hedef odaklı atölyeler, özel yan etkinlikler, içerik üretimi ve topluluk odaklı girişimler aracılığıyla Avalanche'ın benimsenmesini destekler ve ekosisteme yeni kullanıcılar ile projeler kazandırır. Çevrimiçi ve fiziksel topluluklar arasında köprü kurarak yerel inovasyonu güçlendirir ve Avalanche'ın farklı coğrafyalara ve kültürlere yayılmasını sağlar

​ Team1 Türkiye Team1 Türkiye (https://x.com/Team1TUR?utm_source=luma), Avalanche ekosistemini büyütmek ve Web3 dünyasına yeni yetenekler kazandırmak için çalışan resmi bir topluluk yapılanmasıdır. Bugüne kadar Türkiye genelinde 60'tan fazla etkinlik düzenleyerek 4.500 katılımcıya ulaşan Team1 Türkiye, 30'dan fazla üniversiteyle iş birliği yaparak Avalanche'ı kampüslere taşımış ve birçok öğrenci ile geliştiricinin ekosisteme ilk adımını atmasını sağlamıştır. Team1 Türkiye, yerel topluluklarla kurduğu güçlü bağlar sayesinde büyümeye devam ederken daha fazla öğrenciyi ve geliştiriciyi ekosisteme kazandırmayı hedeflemektedir

​ PRU Blockchain Kulübü PRU Blockchain (https://x.com/pru_blockchain), Piri Reis Üniversitesi’nde merkeziyetsiz teknolojilere meraklı öğrencileri bir araya getiren genç bir topluluk. Yeni kurulduk, ama heyecanımız büyük: eğitimler, teknik içerikler ve etkinliklerle birlikte öğreniyor, birlikte üretiyoruz. İlk hackathon birinciliğimizi şimdiden aldık; devamı için çalışıyoruz.

name: Tokenized Assets Are Here. Is Your Desk Ready to Trade Them?
description:
The Big Whale (https://www.thebigwhale.io/) is the leading Market Intelligence provider on Digital Assets, serving 150+ banks, asset managers, fintechs and digital asset companies. Join TBW (https://www.thebigwhale.io/), Morgan Stanley (https://www.morganstanley.com/), and other leading players for an exclusive Corporate After Bell event in New York City. Tokenized stocks, funds and bonds are now live, and issuance is no longer the bottleneck. The harder question is what happens after: where these assets trade, who provides liquidity, and how they move through custody, settlement and reporting. Most issuers earn their revenue at issuance and have little reason to build the secondary market. That leaves the job to venues, broker-dealers and banks. Some will plug tokenized assets into the desks and systems they already run. Others will build new ones. The choice will decide who captures the flows. Thanks to Morgan Stanley for making this event possible. Attending? Share your presence with a dedicated visual here! name: AI x Strategy Workshop
description:
Build a strategy for your own business in 90 minutes, using what you already pay for.

Most people using AI are doing the same thing. One chat window, one question, one answer, close the tab. It works, it is mildly useful, and it is a fraction of what you are already paying for.

This session is for people past the beginner stage who have hit a ceiling. You know the tools. Nobody has shown you the shape they go in.

Your Host

Nabeel, from London now living in Abu Dhabi, runs Fifty Third Street, a consultancy working with pre-Series A startups, and is Managing Partner at Capital57. He has spent twenty years in startups and the last few building the AI systems he now runs his own businesses on.

What we do in the session

You bring your own numbers. Nothing theoretical, nothing from somebody else's case study.

In 90 minutes you work out where your business actually sits, what your competitors are really doing, and what it would take to move. You leave with a strategy document you wrote yourself, and a task that updates autonomously.

All of it on your own laptop, in your own account.

What you leave with

A one page strategy document for your business. A monthly task that keeps it current without you. Five prompts you can point at anything. A readiness score, taken at the start and again at the end. And a cheat sheet for your industry, in your inbox before you reach the car park.

What this is not

No slides about the future of work. No tools you have to go and buy. Everything we use is already inside a subscription you have.

Who it is for

Owners and senior people in small businesses who already use AI most weeks and suspect they are using a tenth of it.

Who it is not for

Anyone who has not used Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini before. You would spend the session watching rather than building. There will be a separate session for that.

How it works

By application. There is preparation to do in the week before, and it is the difference between a useful session and a wasted one. Sessions are recorded for our own notes, and applying counts as agreeing to that.

Three things you need before the day

1. A paid Claude account. The entry tier is enough. Free accounts cannot do the last half hour of this session.

2. The Claude desktop app, installed and signed in.

3. Signed in to the Google account you actually use for work, in the same browser.

And the preparation

Everything you build comes out of what you bring. Thin preparation, thin strategy document. Have these ready as files or notes:

- Your last three months of revenue, split by what you sell.
- Your top ten customers.
- Your current prices.
- Anyone you lost in the last six months, and why.
- Your team size and who does what.
- One page in your own words on what you think is going wrong.
- And the names of three competitors.

None of it leaves your own account or domain.

name: L’écosystème fintech montréalais à l’heure de la tokenisation
description:
La tokenisation n'est plus une promesse technologique. Les cadres réglementaires convergent aux États-Unis, en Europe, à Hong Kong et au Canada. Les institutions financières s'organisent en consortiums, et les stablecoins s'imposent progressivement comme de véritables rails de paiement. Montréal possède solides atouts pour prendre part à cette transformation: un écosystème fintech mature, des talents spécialisés en finance et en technologies numériques, ainsi qu'une expertise reconnue en intelligence artificielle. La métropole bénéficie également d'un savoir-faire concret dans les domaines de la chaîne de blocs, du Web3 et de la DeFi, avec des entreprises et des équipes capables de mener des projets d'envergure au Québec comme à l'international. Lors de cet événement de la communauté CFI, Finance Montréal et T-RIZE présenteront les grandes tendances qui façonnent l'avenir de la finance numérique et discuteront du rôle que le Québec peut jouer dans le développement de l'économie tokenisée. À partir des faits saillants du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et d'une analyse des avancées récentes en matière de tokenisation, nous verrons pourquoi Montréal offre un environnement particulièrement favorable aux initiatives liées aux actifs numériques et aux infrastructures financières de nouvelle génération. Programme 1. Accueil et dîner 2. Présentation du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026 et portrait de l'écosystème fintech montréalais 3. L'écosystème montréalais de la tokenisation 4. Période de questions et échanges entre pairs Présentateurs
Bruno Séguin, directeur principal, Comptes stratégiques, Finance Montréal
- Jean-Luc Pellerin, directeur, Écosystème et partenariats stratégiques, T-RIZE Ce que vous allez retirer de cet événement
Un portrait à jour de l'écosystème fintech montréalais, tiré du Rapport Fintech Québec 2026;

name: Tokenizar valores en Europa: ¿España o Luxemburgo?
description:
El régimen legal de Luxemburgo para la tokenización de valores ha suscitado interés en España durante los últimos años, aunque sus características siguen siendo desconocidas en buena parte del sector. En esta sesión, compararemos los dos marcos legales, el español y el luxemburgués, para entender las ventajas y desventajas de cada uno, con el apoyo de nuestros socios de Legal Node.

Nos centramos en la tokenización de instrumentos financieros (security tokens), a diferencia de los criptoactivos sujetos a MiCA.

De qué hablaremos

- ¿Qué instrumentos se pueden tokenizar en cada país y cómo (tokenización nativa frente a representación digital)?
- Límites legales y efectos sobre la propiedad.
- ERIR (España) frente a Control Agent (Luxemburgo): funciones y responsabilidades de cada figura.
- Prendas, y garantías y su ejecución sobre instrumentos tokenizados.
- Estructuras legales para la de tokenización: fondos, vehículos de titulización y estructuras de financiación. Tokenizar el vehículo frente a tokenizar su deuda.
- Negociación secundaria y futuro de la regulación.

Ponentes

- Ignacio Jiménez, socio de Legal Node
- Álvaro Garrido, socio de Legal Node
- Miguel Calero, director ejecutivo de ISBE en Alastria

Co se stane s vašimi bitcoiny, až tu jednou nebudete?

Na dalším pražském meetupu Jednadvacet přivítáme Michaela Haase, seniorního produktového designéra v Trezoru. Společně se podíváme na bitcoinové dědictví, nástroje, které Bitcoin nabízí, a kompromisy mezi bezpečností, soukromím a jednoduchostí.

Probereme:

- Proč je dědictví důležitou součástí self-custody.
- Časové zámky, multisig a podmínky pro utrácení bitcoinů.
- Jak připravit přístup pro blízké, aniž bychom jim předali kontrolu příliš brzy.
- Jak dědický plán udržovat při změně peněženky, klíčů nebo rodinné situace.

Čekají vás praktické příklady, technický kontext a prostor na otázky. Univerzální řešení pro každého neexistuje, proto se budeme bavit i o omezeních a dlouhodobé správě takového plánu.
